description: This file contains unit tests for the HealthController in a Spring Boot application. It uses MockMvc to simulate HTTP requests and verify responses related to health and status endpoints, mocking the HealthService dependencies.

classes.name: test_HealthControllerWebMvcTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing the HealthController endpoints using MockMvc and Mockito, including tests for health status and database status endpoints.

methods.name: health_whenServiceUp_returns200AndUpStatus
methods.description: Tests that the /health endpoint returns an HTTP 200 with 'UP' status when the health service reports the system as healthy.

methods.name: status_whenDbDown_returns503AndDownDatabase
methods.description: Tests that the /status endpoint returns an HTTP 503 with 'DOWN' database status when the database health check reports down.

methods.name: healthDb_isAliasForStatus
methods.description: Tests that the /health/db endpoint correctly reports the database as down when the health service indicates.
